name: TextLink
description: Themed in-copy link / anchor. Color can be a solid or a CSS gradient. Bold and underline come from the theme (defaults: #252525, bold, no underline) and can be overridden per instance.

as.description: Rendered element. Use `span` for in-copy legal links without navigation.

textColor.description: Override theme colors.linkColor. Solid hex or CSS gradient. Omit to use --lola-link-color.

bold.description: Override theme styles.linkBold. Unset follows the theme (default true).

underline.description: Override theme styles.linkUnderline. Unset follows the theme (default false).

advanced.title: In-copy legal text
advanced.description: Keeps theme color/weight/underline without a real href.

advanced.title: Gradient + underline override
advanced.description: Instance overrides win over the theme CSS variables.

cssVariables.name: --lola-link-text-decoration
cssVariables.description: underline when styles.linkUnderline is true, else none

keyboard: Enter / Space when rendered as a or button
accessibility.notes: When as="span", the host should keep the surrounding sentence readable; add role="link" and keyboard handlers if the span is interactive.

notes: Missing keys use #252525, bold, no underline.
Existing .text-link class names pick up the same CSS variables.
